choices.content: Choose 2 of 4 students to form a group, without regard to order
Put 4 books into a pile, without distinguishing left from right
Choose 2 of 4 students and arrange them in order
Consider only which people were selected

question.prompt: Which of the following is a permutation?

solutions.explanation:
A permutation involves arranging items in order. Forming a group without regard to order is a combination.

C explicitly requires an ordered selection, whereas A and D disregard order. If B means an unordered pile, the unique answer is C. If B means a vertical stack of distinct books whose top-to-bottom order is distinguished, swapping the top two books changes the arrangement, so B is also a permutation. Ignoring left and right does not rule out vertical order. Thus C is the intended answer under the unordered-pile interpretation of B; under the ordered-stack interpretation, both B and C qualify.
